summary: Copyparty is a self-contained file server that runs on Python without mandatory external dependencies. It provides file management capabilities such as resumable uploads, deduplication, media indexing, and protocol support like WebDAV and FTP.
goodFor: Deploying a lightweight, portable file sharing and management solution quickly on a local network or a standalone server without complex infrastructure setup.
watchOut: It has a large codebase packed with many disparate features, which might make deep customisation or auditing more complex than using simpler, single-purpose alternatives.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your files and place the application behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
